messages.subject: Plots overlay [shiny&ggvis]
parts:
Hi,
I learn to use R a few month ago and just start to build my first dashboard. 
My dashboard looks good if the window is maximized. But when I make the window smaller, the plots in the same fluidrow will overlay.
I have attached my ui code and screenshot here. Anyone know how to fix it? Thanks a lot!

The left plot is "plot1", right one is "plot2".

library(shiny)
library(ggvis)

shinyUI(fluidPage(
  titlePanel("Donation Dashboard"),
  
  fluidRow(
    column(3,
           wellPanel(
             h4("Filter:"),
             sliderInput("ddonation",
                         "Choose the Range of Donation Amount:",
                         min = 0,
                         max = 2800,
                         step = 200,
                         value = c(400, 2000)),
             br(),
             sliderInput("dyear",
                         "Year of Donation",
                         min = 2000,
                         max = 2015,
                         step = 1,
                         value = c(2005,2015))
             
           ),
           wellPanel(
             selectInput("dataset1",
                         "Choose Source of Contribution",
                         choices = c("Individuals","Bequests","Corporations","Fundations"))
           )
           ),
    column(9,
           fluidRow(
             ggvisOutput("plot3")
           ),
           fluidRow(
             column(5,
                    ggvisOutput("plot1")
             ),
             column(7,
                    ggvisOutput("plot2")
           )
           
           )
  )
  )))
